messages.subject: Project Lyra — draft Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

Heads of terms attached. The headline commercials our client is proposing: £4.5m upfront, a £2m milestone on first commercial sale, a 6.5% running royalty, and a £750k minimum annual royalty from year three. Exclusive within the defence/aerospace field, worldwide subject to export control. Clauses 9–11 (confidentiality, exclusivity to 30 June, governing law) are intended to be binding.

We'd be grateful for a mark-up or a call.

James Osei
Senior Associate

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Lyra — draft Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Marrick is broadly comfortable with the shape. Two flags for the definitive: (1) the royalty rate feels high given the integration risk Marrick carries — expect us to push on that; (2) they will want a longer runway to first commercial sale than 30 months. Happy to sign the HoT as drafted on the understanding those are live points for the licence.

Oliver
